description: Roman nucleated settlement with a Romano-Celtic type temple identified. Two ditches run parallel to the temple and contained large amounts of cremated animal bones and urns. The settlement appears to have been abandoned in the later 3rd CE, but the temple could have been earlier. Unclear dating as to its construction.
